title: Announcing Mastra Launch
summary: Full enterprise access and hands-on FDE support to get your agent live within 90 days.
body_markdown:
Tens of thousands of organizations are building their agents with Mastra. Companies like Salesforce, WorkOS, MongoDB and many others have deployed agents in software, healthcare, and financial services.


We also meet a lot of teams who are building on Mastra but haven't gotten to production yet. They have a use case picked out, a working prototype, and a clear idea of what they want to ship. What they need is help getting it live.


So today we're announcing **Mastra Launch** : full enterprise access and hands-on FDE support to get your agent live within 90 days.


## How it works


Mastra Launch gives you two things:


1. **Mastra Enterprise Platform access:** Full use of production deployment, observability, controls, and all enterprise features, deployed on Mastra's platform or hosted on your own infra.
2. **Hands-on support from the Mastra team:** a Mastra engineer working alongside your team every week, with one goal: get your agent into production within 90 days.


Mastra is an open-source framework, and it works with every model and every platform, so when you build with Mastra, you own your agents in a way that's not true elsewhere.


We want to show it's possible to get agents into prod, so if your agent isn't in production in 90 days, all you pay is the implementation fee (which pays the salary of your FDE, but we're basically losing money in this case).


## Who it's for


Mastra Launch is for teams that are already building with Mastra, have a specific project defined, and haven't shipped it to production yet.


Usually these teams know what they want to build. But there's a difference between having the confidence and muscle memory of having shipped an agent, and the tentativeness of your first time. Launch gives you an engineer who has done it before.


## Get started


If you have a Mastra project you want in production in the next 90 days,[grab time with our team](https://calendly.com/mastra-team/launch) to learn more.
